name: Myanmar
value: Airstrike on Rakhine camp killed 12 (13 Nov)
summary: A military airstrike on a Rakhine displacement camp killed 12 on 13 Nov, AFP reported; no major city changed hands
state: Witnesses told AFP that a military airstrike on the Byar La displacement camp in Ponnagyun township, Rakhine State, killed 12 people including a child and injured 18 on 13 Nov; the military could not be reached for comment (New Straits Times, 14 Nov). Airstrikes in Rakhine remain frequent, but searches on 20 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine and other conflict areas face airstrikes and displacement. UK nationals should follow FCDO travel advice for Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation
